House full of peace and nature near BarcelonaDo you like Barcelona but you're put off by its overcrowding, its pollution levels, its high prices and its infernal pace? Badalona is your ideal destination, due to its proximity to the sea and its proximity to Barcelona, a city that maintains its vocation as a village. If you are also looking to escape from the pollution of the capital in an environment of peace, tranquillity, exceptional views and surrounded by nature, Canyet is the place for you.In this context, Engel & Völkers presents this magnificent property of 247 m2 built in 1964 and totally refurbished in 2007. Situated on a plot of 749 m2, it is located in the Serra de Can Mas in the heart of the Serralada Marina Park, among trees and greenery, but not isolated and lacking services in its vicinity.It is a 4-storey house built on 2 independent floors, with 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms.We enter the hall on the 1st floor, at street level, and we can access indistinctly to two double bedrooms, to a complete bathroom, to a suite with a bathroom, to the large fully equipped kitchen or to the large living-dining room of 36m2, with South orientation and with large windows and exit to a terrace, with magnificent views over the mountain and the garden itself, which has electric awnings.In terms of equipment, the doors are varnished solid wood, the windows are white aluminium with double glazing, the ceiling of the living room is covered in wood and it has split type air conditioning, propane gas heating by radiators, all the lighting is led type and all the blinds on this floor are motorised. It also has solar panels for heating the running water.The lower floor, at garden level, is presided over by a grandiose 70m2 porch that is completely open on the sides, but which can be closed in its entirety by means of a system of motorised transparent awnings that allow it to be insulated from the outside on cooler or windier days. This becomes the star room of the house as soon as summer arrives and the days get longer.On this same level, on the right, we find a small flat of about 47m2 with a completely independent entrance, consisting of a living-dining room, kitchen, a double bedroom and a toilet.On the left side is the propane gas storage room and then several independent rooms used as a workshop, warehouse or wine cellar.The porch overlooks the extensive garden of natural grass, with a variety of trees and plants, all carefully maintained and where, at the back, there is a barbecue and, at a slightly lower level, a swimming pool and play area for the youngest members of the family.In short, a haven of peace in the heart of nature, just a few minutes from Barcelona.Canyet is one of the most coveted areas of Badalona due to its privileged location in the heart of nature, its special microclimate that softens the extreme temperatures, its spectacular views and the tranquillity it offers, without being far from the large urban concentrations of Badalona or Barcelona, its services and shops.There are several quality restaurants a little more than 100 metres away (Talós, Molí de Cal Dimoni,...), an area of small shops in Bufalá 1 km away, the Montigalà Shopping Centre and the large department stores Ikea, Decathlon, Lidl, Bon Preu or Mercadona just over 1.5 km away and sports areas such as the football pitch and the sports hall of Bufalá or the Badalona Tennis Club between 1 and 1.5 km away or the Can Pujol Riding Club 300 metres away. As for education, the prestigious Escola Garbí-Pere Vergés is located just over 1 km away and the Laie de Montgat International School is 3 km away, as well as various nurseries in the surrounding area.It is very close (600 metres) to the prestigious Germans Trias i Pujol University Hospital (Can Ruti), a medical centre of reference and excellence in Catalonia.In terms of communications, its situation is excellent. It is 900 metres from the C-31, which allows access to Barcelona in.

description: REF BCN-20We exclusively present this beautiful apartment in the heart of El Born of 160m, there are two united apartments (two registration entities) one of 74m and the other of 86m.Currently they are joined inside, it has two living rooms, one of 30m and the other of 18m, it has four double bedrooms, two bathrooms and a toilet, a large kitchen of 15m and another auxiliary kitchen of 6m.The house is all exterior and has original elements, wooden beams, large exterior windows, high ceilings, it is a second floor without an elevator, the property is completely restored, both facades and common elements, it also has a community terrace prepared for so you can enjoy quiet afternoons or with friends.The Born neighborhood is one of the most fascinating and charming neighborhoods in Barcelona, Spain. It is located in the Ciutat Vella district, in the heart of the city. El Born is famous for its bohemian atmosphere, its narrow, cobbled streets, as well as its rich history and wide cultural offering.One of the main attractions of the neighborhood is the famous El Born market, or Mercat de Sant Pere, an impressive modernist-style building where you can find fresh produce, local foods and a wide variety of shops and restaurants. In addition, in the market there is the Center of Culture and Memory, which houses the archaeological remains of medieval Barcelona.El Born is also known for its picturesque squares, such as Plaça de Sant Pere, Plaça de les Olles and Plaça del Fossar de les Ctra, the latter dedicated to those who fell during the siege of Barcelona in 1714.The neighborhood has a large number of independent fashion stores, design boutiques and artisan workshops, making it an ideal place for lovers of unique and original purchases. In addition, its streets are full of tapas bars, Catalan cuisine restaurants and cozy cafes, where you can enjoy local cuisine.El Born is also a neighborhood with a great cultural offer. It houses numerous museums, such as the Picasso Museum, which displays an extensive collection of works by the famous Spanish painter, and the Barcelona History Museum, which tells the history of the city from its Roman origins. In addition, the neighborhood is full of art galleries and cultural spaces that offer exhibitions, concerts and events throughout the year.

description: MYLIFE REAL ESTATE presents this beautiful fully renovated apartment for sale in a restored royal estate in one of the most fashionable areas of the city, El Born.property descriptionThis house is located on the second floor with an elevator of a beautiful classic building dating from 1890. The apartment has been completely renovated using top quality materials and finishes. It has a modern and functional design in perfect harmony with its original elements such as the high ceilings with wooden beams and Catalan vaults and the exposed stone and brick walls.The house has a large open space where the dining room is located, with access to an exterior balcony overlooking a quiet pedestrian street. The house has two double suites, each with its own bathroom, and a dressing area.Among its improvements it has natural oak parquet floors, a complete lighting system with spotlights in all rooms and heating, and hot water by aerothermal energy, and air conditioning.Old TownCiutat Vella is the historic center of Barcelona and occupies a small territory of about 500 hectares. To know Ciutat Vella is to know the origins of Barcelona, a capital that until the middle of the 19th century lived enclosed in its medieval walls, which roughly followed Paral·lel avenue, Sant Pau roundabout, Sant Antoni roundabout, Calle de Pelai, the Lluís Companys promenade and the Ciutadella park.Of the set of these walls, demolished in 1854, the only fragment that remains standing is the one associated with the medieval shipyards (Les Drassanes, now the Museu Marítim), in the so-called Portal de Santa Madrona. Ciutat Vella is made up of four large neighbourhoods. In the center is the Barri Gòtic, the oldest Barcelona urban fabric. To the east, on the other side of Via Laietana, Sant Pere, Santa Caterina and La Ribera —where the Born is located— and which are the medieval extension of the Gòtic. To the west, on the other side of La Rambla, El Raval, which was born from the rural roads outside the city walls and which was the cradle of the Industrial Revolution of the 19th century. And to the south, Barceloneta, the fishing district built in the 18th century to rehouse those displaced from the Ribera by the construction of Ciutadella, a military fortress.The urban fabric of this district, irregular and variegated, as if it were a palimpsest, accumulates the traces of the last two thousand years of history, from Roman Barcino to multicultural and avant-garde 21st century Barcelona, passing through Barchinona de the Middle Ages, a set of extraordinary monumental, cultural, gastronomic, artistic and street attractions that must be savored without haste.

These details make this building a unique piece that radiates singular beauty in the heart of Barcelona.The garden of 'Villa Tibidabo' has an unusual trapezoidal shape and is originally attributed to the architect Antoni Gaudí, with subsequent interventions that have given it its current appearance. Additionally, on this floor, there is a spectacular terrace, a summer dining area under a unique pergola supported by eight columns that frame a centennial wisteria. There is also a living area and a pool overlooking Barcelona.The upper floor, designated as the nighttime area, includes three suite-type bedrooms, each with its own bathroom. The master bedroom offers two bathrooms, two dressing rooms, and direct access to the terrace with views of Barcelona. The basement houses two individual rooms, one of which is currently used as a gym and the other as a suite with a bathroom. In addition, there is a dining area, a water area, and a machinery room or cellar.The second residence, currently rented, has an independent entrance and presents itself as a duplex with a built area of 208 square meters and a garden of 574 square meters with modernist elements designed by Gaudí. Distributed over two floors and with a tower with a lookout terrace, this residence allows you to enjoy panoramic views that stretch from the coast of Calella to the Garraf and also encompass a significant part of El Vallès to Montserrat.The first floor of this second residence features a living-dining room, a separate kitchen, and three bedrooms, two of which are doubles, as well as two bathrooms. The second floor has a double suite-type bedroom with a dressing room and access to a terrace. Outside, this property offers a covered summer dining area, a spacious garden, a pool, and a historic lookout known as the 'Mirador de la Reina.'All the spaces of 'Villa Tibidabo' are characterized by their spaciousness, brightness, and high ceilings with elegant moldings and stuccos. The floors combine hydraulic tiles and parquet, while the valuable marble fireplaces and 18th and 19th-century French and English furniture add a touch of luxury and sophistication.In summary, this property is a true dream home for those seeking an exceptional residence.

This exceptional apartment, with an interior area of 172 square meters and an interior patio of 70 square meters, is located in a historic building constructed in 1860 on Portaferrissa Street, in the heart of Barcelona's old town.
